names.en: One Step Back, Sea and Sky Expands

summary.text: One Step Back, Sea and Sky Expands is an immortal killer move. It is a support move to manage the immortal aperture and has no offensive power.

claims.text: Lang Ya land spirit controls the Long Hair refinement path formation while Fang Yuan’s time path clone watches. In about a month the seal of Lang Ya’s origin core will be fully removed. After Long Hair Ancestor died, Lang Ya heavenly spirit used a refinement path killer move to seal that origin core. Its rank fell to a red rank seven origin core, and the heavenly spirit became a land spirit, so later calamities and tribulations were at rank seven.

Lang Ya land spirit says he is only mimicking. His main body obtained the method from Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable, who obtained it from Limitless Demon Venerable’s inheritance. It was originally a rule path killer move named ‘one step back’. Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable modified it extensively into the space path killer move ‘sea and sky expands’. Lang Ya land spirit turned it into a refinement path version, which he does not count as a modification or improvement, so he fused the former two names. Fang Yuan obtained this method. If it leaked, the number of Gu Immortals would surge by many times, even tens of times. Limitless Demon Venerable and Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable could accumulate dao marks and pass tribulations without the usual pressure.

Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool can utilize this among other refinement path killer moves, including slumbering lightning python, wind grind, reflect snow, muffled thunder stone drum, dragon-shaped blizzard, heavenly light ring, refinement snake lifespan flower, and omnipresent four seas.
